items_all.title: AMD's upcoming Zen 6 processors could fix microstutters and improve 1% lows in games — Next-gen CPUs tipped to feature per-core optimizations for thermal and power budgets
items_all.summary: A new report suggests AMD is cooking up a range of per-core optimizations for Zen 6 that might not seem huge on their own, but they could add up to make a world of difference in gaming performance.
items_all.title_original: AMD's upcoming Zen 6 processors could fix microstutters and improve 1% lows in games — Next-gen CPUs tipped to feature per-core optimizations for thermal and power budgets
items_all.title_en: AMD's upcoming Zen 6 processors could fix microstutters and improve 1% lows in games — Next-gen CPUs tipped to feature per-core optimizations for thermal and power budgets
items_all.title_bilingual: AMD's upcoming Zen 6 processors could fix microstutters and improve 1% lows in games — Next-gen CPUs tipped to feature per-core optimizations for thermal and power budgets
items_all.summary_zh: 一份新报告表明，AMD 正在为 Zen 6 制定一系列每核心优化措施，这些优化措施本身看起来并不大，但它们加起来可能会在游戏性能方面产生巨大的差异。

items_all.title: RTX 5060 Ti survives car crash after being bent in half — short PCB saves the day, single memory chip resolder restore full performance
items_all.summary: What happens when a graphics card gets in a car crash? If you're lucky, the damage is limited to just cosmetic scars that can go away over time with no serious damage under-the-hood.
items_all.title_original: RTX 5060 Ti survives car crash after being bent in half — short PCB saves the day, single memory chip resolder restore full performance

items_all.summary_zh: 当显卡遭遇车祸时会发生什么？如果幸运的话，损伤仅限于美容疤痕，随着时间的推移，这些疤痕会消失，而不会造成严重的内部损伤。
